entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.

I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I have your name and order number? And just to be clear, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
The name is Alex Chen, order 774-B. It's a technical fault. The heart rate monitor is a piece of garbage. It's wildly inaccurate.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with the accuracy. We can definitely try a few troubleshooting steps to see if we can resolve that for you. Sometimes a quick reset or firmware update...
No. I don't have time for that. I just want my money back. I want a refund.
I understand you're frustrated and just want a resolution. Let me pull up your account and our return policy to see what the options are. One moment, Alex.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I see here that your VeloBand Pulse was delivered 15 days ago. Looking at our policy, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery, so you're well within the timeframe.
Yes, absolutely. I'm processing the return for you right now. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on file. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse scans the item.
Whatever. Just make sure the label shows up.

It's been sent. And Alex, I see you're a long-time VIP member with us. For the trouble you've had with this new product, I'd like to add a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. You can use that on any future purchase.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
